PostgreSQL-native biological sequence analysis

A normal SELECT becomes a sequence search the moment mmsearch() appears in the WHERE clause.

CREATE EXTENSION bioseq;

SQL showcase

SELECT bioseq.len(sequence) FROM reads;
SELECT id FROM reads WHERE mmsearch(sequence, 'ACGT');
